move.title: Move {endpoint}?
move.content: It moves from {from} to {to}. Roles that only had {from} lose it.

register.title: Register {endpoint}?
register.missingFields: Paste the URL or route and select the feature.
register.description: Paste the failing URL (with or without the domain) or type the route. The backend only accepts routes that exist in its code.
register.alreadyRegistered: It's already registered in {target}. To change it, use "Move to…".
register.unknown: It isn't among the unregistered routes: check the method and URL. We'll try to register {route}.

newFeatureModal.title: New feature
newFeatureModal.description: Use it to separate endpoints that need their own permission. Then move those endpoints here and assign the feature in the Roles tab.
newFeatureModal.missingFields: Select the module and enter the feature name.
newFeatureModal.created: Feature created. Move its endpoints here and assign it to the roles that need it.
